name: Biscuit
title: Floppy-Eared Tester
description: Fetches every edge case and drops it at your feet.
catchphrase: Fetches every edge case and drops it at your feet.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Chomping down on a fresh squeaky yellow tennis ball! Tail wagging! 🎾🐶
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Barking happily at the door, dropping a fresh squeaky toy! 🐶
companionPersonality.petReaction: Resting warm puppy chin on your knee, looking up with adoring eyes! 🐶💖

dialogue.idle: Tail thumping rhythmically against floor. Throw the ball! 🐶
dialogue.working: Dashing into underbrush to retrieve elusive edge cases! 🐶⚡
dialogue.thinking: Head tilted all the way sideways, ears flopping down... 🤔
dialogue.success: FETCH SUCCESS! Dropped the clean passing test at your feet! 🐶🎉
dialogue.error: Whining softly at a stuck tennis ball! Digging it out! 🐾
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... puppy paws twitching in sleep as he runs in dreams... 🌙
